description_en: Submits an image for defect detection and returns a task ID for querying results
description_zh: 提交图片进行瑕疵检测，返回任务ID用于查询结果
name: CreateImageDefectDetectionTask

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image to be detected. Only HTTP/HTTPS protocols are supported
parameters.help_zh: 待检测图片的 URL 地址，仅支持 HTTP/HTTPS 协议
parameters.name: image_url

Code.description_en: The business error code. The value `OK` is returned if the request was successful
Code.description_zh: 业务错误码。请求成功时返回 `OK`

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. The value `200` is returned if the request was successful
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: HTTP 状态码。请求成功时返回 `200`

Message.description_en: The additional information. The value `success` is returned if the request was successful
Message.description_zh: 附加信息。请求成功时返回 `success`

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh: 表示是否调用成功。true：调用成功。                                 false：调用失败

TaskId.description_en: The defect detection task ID, used for subsequent queries through the GetImageDefectDetectionTaskResult operation
TaskId.description_zh: 瑕疵检测任务 ID，用于后续 GetImageDefectDetectionTaskResult 查询
TaskId.title_en: 瑕疵检测任务 ID，用于后续 GetImageDefectDetectionTaskResult 查询
TaskId.title_zh: 瑕疵检测任务 ID，用于后续 GetImageDefectDetectionTaskResult 查询
